author: Nellyslife
title: Hiring Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer for Characters & Branding
content:
📣 HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines)
Remote · Project-based · Start ASAP

Apply by email only: team.nellyslife@gmail.com
Send your portfolio, rates and availability, with the subject line “Freelance Illustrator / Designer – [Your Name]”.
DMs and comments won’t be considered.

WHAT YOU'LL DESIGN: DOODLES · characters & mascots; BRANDING · logos, colors, type; PACKAGING · cups, bags, stickers; MERCH · tees, caps, aprons, totes; PRINT · menus, posters, signage; ONLINE · social & web graphics.
YOU BRING: A playful, recognizable doodle style; Branding & packaging experience (F&B a plus); Illustrator, Photoshop or Procreate; Clean, print-ready files; Good communication in English; Based in the Philippines.

title: MirrorShade Studios Hiring Character & Creature Concept Artist
content:
WE’RE HIRING | MirrorShade Studios – Bangkok, Thailand

We’re looking for a talented Character & Creature Concept Artist to join our growing team and help bring our debut title to life.

We're seeking an artist with strong visual storytelling skills, a distinctive creative voice, and a passion for creating memorable characters and creatures.

Good working English is important.

Other positions still open:
3D Character Animator
3D Character Artist
Game Designer

Bangkok, Thailand
